property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the TOCStyleEntry (a TOCStyle).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the TOCStyleEntry within its containing object.

property.name: formatStyle
property.shortdesc: The paragraph style applied to the TOC entry. Can return: ParagraphStyle or String.

property.name: level
property.shortdesc: The indent level of the entry in the TOC.

property.name: pageNumberStyle
property.shortdesc: The character style applied to the page number of the entry. Can return: CharacterStyle or String.

property.name: pageNumberPosition
property.shortdesc: The page number placement for the TOC entry style.

property.name: separator
property.shortdesc: The string to insert between the entry text and the page numbers.

property.name: separatorStyle
property.shortdesc: The character style applied to the string separating the TOC entry text and the page numbers. Can return: CharacterStyle or String.

property.name: sortAlphabet
property.shortdesc: If true, sorts the entries alphabetically.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the TOCStyleEntry.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
